senses.gloss: f. (נוּחַ Hif.) putting down, depositing, laying down (v. הֵינוּחַ).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 22b:7">Sabb. 22ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>ה׳ עושה מצוה</he> the real religious ceremony consists in putting the lights in their appropriate place.
<cite ref="Shabbat 4a">Ib. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>עקירה וה׳</he> the lifting up (of a burden on the Sabbath) and the putting down.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:8">Kel. VIII, 8</cite> <he>מקום הַנָּחַת העצים</he> the place (in the oven) where the wood is placed.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:1">Ib. XXII, 1</cite> <he>מקום הנחת וכ׳</he> enough (left of the side board) to set down the cups; enough … to set down portions of meat; Y. Ab. Zar. II, end, 42ᵃ <he>היא מקים ה׳ הכוסות וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="V00390"><he>תחת</he></cite>) both terms mean the same.
<cite ref="Taanit 2b:1">Taan. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 4a:14">4ᵃ</cite> <he>משעת הַנָּחָתוֹ</he> from the time it (the Lulab) is stored away (the seventh day of Succoth).
